searchText: M.S.R.P. $265,155 - The New 2026 Entegra Launch 19Y AWD is brought to life by a 2.0L 4-Cylinder diesel engine with 211HP and 332 ft.-lb. torque and is approximately 19 feet 7 inches in length. This impressive vehicle includes the optional customer value package. The new 2026 launch features the lithionics system which includes a 48V lithium battery bringing 165 Ah, 3,000W Victron Pure Sine Wave inverter, NeverDie battery management system, 48V secondary alternator, Intermotive High-Idle charge system, 12,500 48V Coleman Mach 10 air conditioner and 200W solar. The extremely capable Launch AWD Class B RV features luxurious amenities like Technoform® European-style cabinetry provide a sleek, modern look while a Firefly Multiplex system provides ease of use.
